payload.core_mechanism_summary: Count initial inversions with Fenwick tree (BIT), then update parity by adding d*(d-1)//2 for each reversed segment of length d.
payload.rationale: Uses Fenwick tree for initial O(n log n) inversion count. Queries handled in O(1) by noting reversal flips pair order within segment, changing parity depending on d choose 2 odd/even. No complete search involved.
